TEXT.source: kanakanavu.info, "Mo'o 2014 Story 3", https://kanakanavu.info/language-documentation/moo-2014-story-3.html. This story was recorded by Ilka Wild in collaboration with Elizabeth Zeitoun in March 2014 in Namasia village. The speaker is Mo'o Kangena. The site's phonetic transcription (PT) line only; not aligned to the recording.

mustaɾuʔun kan ma vi:tia ɾumaɾaisi

esi kan inia vi: tia mustaɾu tia ɾumaɾaisi
mu:na kan inia tupuɾu te: ʦi kita makinanu misei kan
